findings.title: exportRows awaits a fetch call inside the loop for every row

evidence.quote:
const response = await fetch(row.url); // planted TD-36: I/O inside the loop
    out.push(await response.text());

findings.note: exportRows awaits fetch(row.url) once per row inside the loop, with no batching or concurrency. Real per-request cost on a hot path (export.ts is in the hotspot band); no ruff-equivalent linter covers TypeScript here, so this is a scout-only finding without tool corroboration.

looks_bad_but_fine.why: kindLabels loops over KINDS, a fixed three-member tuple with a bounded N.
